title: 第十章 下品灵石第十一章 卖血单
lines: 第十章下品灵石
当天晚上，叶欢便买了去桂云的火车票，就在青城对他已经没有意义了。
云贵背后是延绵的山脉，只有这种原始的山脉，出现灵草下品灵石的几率才更大。
他要去试一试，要是能够寻找到下品灵石，他的修炼就简单多了。
因为修炼道决，叶欢知道需要的灵气远远超过普通功法。
按照地球的灵气浓度来看，叶欢估计自己一辈子也迈入不了入圣境，永远也离不开地球。
上了火车，叶欢找到自己的位置坐下，忽然想起，自己的背包还落在锦瑟饭店。
不过火车就要启动了，叶欢也不想去拿了。
虽然那个背包里还有他炼制那些药物，可以说是价值千金，但对于叶欢而言，其实一文不值。
叶欢旁边是一个戴口罩的女孩子，虽然遮住了半边脸，但还是能看出，是个漂亮的女孩子。
在叶欢坐下来后，他旁边的女人眉头明显皱了一下，她不喜欢有人坐她旁边。
她真后悔坐这趟火车，也不明白，为什么自己老爸非要求自己坐火车回去，这么多人，烦死了。
尤其是坐在自己旁边这个男人，长得还算清秀，没想到居然还用香水。
她闻到叶欢身上有一股香味，很舒服的味道，但她不喜欢喷香水的男人。
变态！
她小心翼翼地防备着叶欢，只要她稍微想往里面挤一点，想占自己便宜，她就立马大叫流氓。
不过让胡可意外的是，一连两个小时过去了，这个男人没有丝毫要占便宜的意思。
不仅如此，他连看都没多看自己一眼，一直端坐着闭目养神，发丝都没有动一下。
真是个奇怪的人！
胡可有些忍不住了，想去上厕所，只是叶欢坐在她外面，要去上厕所必须要让叶欢让开。
她不想搭理这个奇怪的人，谁知她站起来，发现不知道什么时候叶欢已经站到过道外面去了。
胡可惊讶地看了叶欢一眼，连忙走了出去，这时，胡可用余光发现叶欢的一只手朝着自己抓来。
她心头一惊，难道这个家伙要非礼自己？
胡可回头，却发现叶欢不是抓的自己，而是正好出现在自己身后的，一个身材丰满的女子的手臂。
她暗自松了口气，心头却鄙视着这个家伙，果然是个变态。
而且还是个没什么眼光的变态，虽然自己带着口罩，但怎么看也比这个丰满艳俗的女人好吧！
“你干什么？耍流氓啊！”这名丰满女人想要大叫挣脱，却发现被叶欢抓着浑身虚弱，连叫喊都很小声。
现在已经是大晚上了，火车上的乘客大都睡了，丰满女人叫喊声不大，没能将他们吵醒。
一些少数看到的乘客，虽然在心中鄙视叶欢耍流氓，却也不愿意多管闲事。
“你等一下。”叶欢拉着丰满女人，对着胡可说道。
胡可一愣，难道他的目标是自己，想要借此机会来占自己便宜？
“你检查一下自己的包，有没有丢什么东西？”叶欢说道。
胡可呆了一下，连忙打开自己包翻找着，却发现一样不少，贵重物品一样不少。
她心头一怒，立刻明白叶欢是故意找借口接近自己，想耍流氓。
“我什么都没丢，请你放开她，流氓！”胡可心中已经把叶欢定位为流氓了，鄙视万分。

Chapter 10 Low Grade Spiritual Stone
That night, Ye Huan bought a train ticket to Guiyun. It was meaningless to him to stay in Qingcheng.
Behind Yunnan and Guizhou are stretches of mountains. Only in such primitive mountains, the chance of appearing low-grade spiritual grass and spiritual stones is greater.
He was going to give it a try. If he could find low-grade spiritual stones, his cultivation would be much simpler.
Because of practicing Dao Jue, Ye Huan knew that the spiritual energy required was far more than ordinary techniques.
Judging from the concentration of the earth's spiritual energy, Ye Huan estimates that he will never be able to enter the holy realm in his lifetime, and will never be able to leave the earth.
After getting on the train, Ye Huan found his seat and sat down. Suddenly he remembered that his backpack was still left at Jinse Hotel.
But the train was about to start, and Ye Huan didn't want to get it.
Although the medicine he refined was still in that backpack, which could be said to be worth thousands of gold, to Ye Huan, it was actually worthless.
Next to Ye Huan is a girl wearing a mask. Although half of her face is covered, it can still be seen that she is a beautiful girl.
After Ye Huan sat down, the woman next to him frowned obviously. She didn't like people sitting next to her.
She really regretted taking this train, and she didn't understand why her father insisted on taking the train back. It was so annoying to see so many people.
Especially the man sitting next to him, who is quite handsome, but he didn't expect that he actually wears perfume.
She smelled a scent on Ye Huan's body, which was very comfortable, but she didn't like men who wore perfume.
abnormal!
She carefully guarded Ye Huan, and as soon as she tried to squeeze in a little bit and take advantage of herself, she would immediately call him a gangster.
But what surprised Hu Ke was that after two hours passed, the man had no intention of taking advantage.
Not only that, he didn't even look at himself. He just sat upright with his eyes closed and didn't move his hair.
What a strange man!
Hu Ke couldn't help it anymore and wanted to go to the toilet, but Ye Huan was sitting outside her. If she wanted to go to the toilet, she had to let Ye Huan get out of the way.
She didn't want to deal with this strange person, but when she stood up, she found that Ye Huan had already stood outside the aisle.
Hu Ke glanced at Ye Huan in surprise and walked out quickly. At this time, Hu Ke noticed from the corner of his eye that one of Ye Huan's hands was grabbing towards him.
She was shocked, could this guy want to molest her?
Hu Ke turned around, only to find that Ye Huan was not grabbing him, but the arm of a plump woman who happened to appear behind him.
She secretly breathed a sigh of relief, but she despised this guy in her heart. He was indeed a pervert.
Moreover, he is still a pervert with little vision. Even though he is wearing a mask, he is still better than this plump and gaudy woman!
"What are you doing? You're acting like a hooligan!" The plump woman wanted to scream and break away, but found that she was weak because of Ye Huan's hold, and she could not even scream.
It was already late at night, and most of the passengers on the train were asleep. The plump woman's screams were not loud enough to wake them up.
Some of the few passengers who saw it despised Ye Huan for being a hooligan, but they were unwilling to meddle in other people's business.
"Wait a moment." Ye Huan pulled the plump woman and said to Hu Ke.
Hu Ke was stunned. Could it be that he was targeting himself and wanted to take this opportunity to take advantage of him?
"Check your bag, have you lost anything?" Ye Huan said.
Hu Ke was stunned for a moment, then quickly opened his bag and rummaged around, only to find a lot of the same things, including a lot of valuables.
She felt angry and immediately understood that Ye Huan was deliberately looking for an excuse to get close to her and wanted to act like a hooligan.
"I haven't lost anything, please let her go, gangster!" Hu Ke has already positioned Ye Huan as a gangster in his heart, and he despises her.
